text.p: HOSPODARSKE NOVINY - Slovakia is preparing a new energy law according to which private subjects could be granted a licence to produce or distribute electric energy. The law is expected to come in effect at the beginning of next year.

- The Slovak finance ministry is preparing an amendment to tax legislation, which cancels tax relief on income from state bonds, and offers tax relief for trading with securities and currencies on behalf of the client.
- VSZ Ocel, the largest company belonging to Slovakia's largest steel producer VSZ a.s., posted an after-tax profit of 463 million crowns, some 19 million more than originally planned.

NARODNA OBRODA - Frantisek Gaulider, a parliamentarian for Slovakia's ruling Movement for a Democratic Slovakia (HZDS) on Tuesday quit the party club as a protest the allleged lack of democracy in Slovakia. His defection from HZDS will reduce its number of deputies to 60 in the 150-seat parliament, but will have no impact on the ruling coalition which together holds 81 seats.
SME - The Slovak Defence Ministry said it had no reports of the so-called "desert storm syndrome" among Slovak veterans who took part in the the Gulf war.
- Privatisation Minister Peter Bisak expects more active trading with privatisation bonds to start by the end of this year.
